title: REMOVE AND REPLACE 13 PROPANE REGULATORS, USCG STA FIRE ISLAND HOUSING, BABYLON, NY 11702-4602
description:
Contractor shall furnish all labor, materials, equipment, transportation, and supervision necessary to remove and replace 13 exterior propane regulator assemblies serving housing boilers at USCG STA Fire Island Housing, Babylon, NY 11702-4602 per the attached Scope of Work. 

 Quote should be a firm fixed price quote and should include the lead time for parts and a specification sheet for those parts. It should also include a detailed quote price breakdown. 

 Quote should also include a completed SF18, with price and UEI included. 

 Evaluation factors:  lowest price technically acceptable.  Please also include past performance information. 

 Questions must be received in writing by 11/30/2026 to Beverly.A.Primm@uscg.mil. 

 Quotes should be sent to Beverly.A.Primm@uscg.mil.
